statusMeanings.supported: A validated feature adapter exists and public deep metrics may include it.
statusMeanings.partial: Diagnostic evidence exists, but it is not yet a supported public deep-metric adapter.
statusMeanings.candidate: Enough encoded evidence exists to build or validate a parser.
statusMeanings.weak: Some markers exist, but not enough to treat as reliable without inspection.
statusMeanings.missing: No useful marker evidence found by this audit.

assumptions: This audit measures encoded evidence, not philological quality.
A candidate result means the dictionary deserves an adapter or parser validation pass before it is promoted.
Equal-depth analysis requires dictionary-specific parsing for grammar, citations, homonymy, and sense segmentation; headword coverage alone is insufficient.
